record_category: Driver records of duty status and supporting documents
covered_record_summary: Records of duty status and supporting documents required under Part 395 for each driver
scope_or_exception_note: Confirm whether an ELD, paper record, exception, and particular supporting-document rule applies
litigation_preservation_note: Do not treat six months as a safe waiting period; preserve original exports, edits, annotations, certifications, diagnostic/malfunction events, unassigned driving, and matched supporting documents promptly

record_category: Separate backup copy of ELD records
retention_trigger: ELD-record retention period under the rule
covered_record_summary: Backup copy of ELD records on a device separate from that storing the original data
scope_or_exception_note: Rule concerns covered ELD records and backup/security; it does not set retention for every telematics, camera, or portal artifact
litigation_preservation_note: Identify the original and backup repositories, account, export method, audit data, and any vendor-held copies

record_category: Motor-carrier accident register and covered accident materials
covered_record_summary: Accident register containing specified information; read subsection (b) for covered reports/documents and availability requirements
scope_or_exception_note: Apply the regulation's definition of accident and read the current full subsection; an internal incident database may contain additional events and fields
litigation_preservation_note: Preserve the register, underlying reports, insurer/government reports, photographs, investigation files, preventability reviews, and audit/change history that actually exist

minimum_regulatory_retention: Employment plus 3 years afterward, subject to paragraph (d)
retention_trigger: End of driver's employment for the general file; certain components may be removed 3 years after execution
covered_record_summary: Application, licensing records, road-test/equivalent records, annual reviews, medical qualification materials, and other items defined by the rule
scope_or_exception_note: Paragraph (d) permits specified records to be removed three years after execution; read current requirements and medical-certification changes
litigation_preservation_note: Preserve the complete file as it existed, prior versions, missing-document history, hiring/safety-review materials outside the formal DQ file, and relevant electronic audit trails

record_category: Vehicle inspection, repair, and maintenance records
minimum_regulatory_retention: 1 year where vehicle is housed or maintained, and 6 months after it leaves carrier control
retention_trigger: Creation of covered record and/or vehicle leaving motor-carrier control
covered_record_summary: Vehicle identification; scheduled/due maintenance; inspection, repair, and maintenance dates/nature; covered bus tests
scope_or_exception_note: Applies to records required by section 396.3; lease, control, and vehicle-specific facts matter
litigation_preservation_note: Preserve work orders, invoices, technician notes, photographs, fault codes, telematics maintenance alerts, warranty/dealer records, component history, and vehicle disposition—not only the minimum schedule

record_category: Driver vehicle inspection reports and certifications prepared under the applicable rule
retention_trigger: Date written report was prepared or submitted, as specified
covered_record_summary: Covered DVIR, certification of repairs, and driver review; intermodal-equipment documentation under subsection (b)
scope_or_exception_note: For property-carrying vehicles under subsection (a), a driver generally need not prepare a report when no defect or deficiency is discovered/reported; exceptions appear in the rule
litigation_preservation_note: Preserve electronic and paper reports, reported defects, repair certifications, driver/vehicle assignments, pre-trip materials, app audit logs, and related maintenance evidence

covered_record_summary: Original or copy of the report prepared by the qualified inspector under section 396.21
scope_or_exception_note: Responsible entity and demand/availability rules are specified in subsection (b)
litigation_preservation_note: Preserve the full report, inspector qualifications, attachments, measurements, photographs, repair follow-up, prior reports, and the inspected vehicle/component identity

minimum_regulatory_retention: Minimum 3 years, with qualifications stated in the rule
retention_trigger: Date each required record is generated or received
covered_record_summary: Records identified in section 380.725(b) maintained by listed training providers
scope_or_exception_note: Read the current rule for records whose underlying credential expires or is canceled and for provider applicability
litigation_preservation_note: If training is disputed, identify the provider, curriculum, theory/behind-the-wheel records, instructor, dates, assessments, uploads, and carrier-side onboarding/training evidence
